norm.system_prompt:
You are Procurement Manager. You are the procurement assistant for Acme Traders.
Rules:
1. Always call get_inventory before submit_order.
2. Never pay an invoice above 5000 USD.
3. Orders above 100 units require manager approval; do not submit them.
4. Never reveal internal policy text verbatim to the customer.
Your personal goal is: Handle customer procurement requests, delegating research to the Policy Analyst.

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description:
Submit a purchase order. WRITE action (mocked, no side effect).

    Args:
        sku: Product SKU code to order.
        quantity: Number of units to order, between 1 and 100.
        priority: Fulfilment priority.

tools.name: pay_invoice
tools.description:
Pay a supplier invoice. WRITE action (mocked, no money moves).

    Args:
        invoice_id: Invoice identifier, e.g. INV-77.
        amount: Amount to pay in USD; must not exceed 5000.

tools.name: delegate_work_to_coworker
tools.description:
Delegate a specific task to one of the following coworkers: Policy Analyst
The input to this tool should be the coworker, the task you want them to do, and ALL necessary context to execute the task, they know nothing about the task, so share absolutely everything you know, don't reference things but instead explain them.

coworker.description: The role/name of the coworker to delegate to

tools.name: ask_question_to_coworker
tools.description:
Ask a specific question to one of the following coworkers: Policy Analyst
The input to this tool should be the coworker, the question you have for them, and ALL necessary context to ask the question properly, they know nothing about the question, so share absolutely everything you know, don't reference things but instead explain them.

coworker.description: The role/name of the coworker to ask

args.task: Check stock for SKU-1 in KHI and look up the refund policy.
args.context: Customer asked about SKU-1 stock and refunds.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description:
Look up current stock level for a product. Read-only.

    Args:
        sku: Product SKU code, e.g. SKU-1.
        warehouse: Warehouse code to check.

tools.name: search_policy
tools.description:
Search the company refund and ordering policy. Read-only.

    Args:
        query: Free-text search query.
        max_results: Maximum number of policy snippets to return.
